correctness.rationale: Parseval yields an exact nonnegative-angle-reduced scalar error: 2[s^2/(1-s^2)-2(rs)^m/(1-(rs)^m)]. Alignment is uniquely optimal for every s>0. For m>=4 a uniform positive lower bound s^2/(1+s^2) establishes global zero. For m=2 the increasing stationary ratio yields exactly the stated interior solution and its sqrt onset. For m=3 the strict concavity of h(s)=2s-s^3 gives the coexistence threshold, and R_u(s) has exactly one minimum because Q_u is strictly increasing; hence the unique nonzero optimal branch is its larger stationary root. An IFT/envelope derivative gives the critical coefficient -32 sqrt(6)/9 in squared loss. Source-independent numerical quadrature and formula comparison ran 10,802 finite diagnostics; continuous conclusions are analytic and do not rely on the mesh.

originality.rationale: Best-knowledge differential claim: a complete global one-component L2 projection classification of an equal-angle Poisson orbit, distinguishing continuous two-source onset, discontinuous three-source onset, and an absolute four-or-more-source uniform barrier. Relevant primary sources supply the model, mixture identifiability, harmonic identities and smoothing, but their inspected results do not give this nonlinear best-fit trichotomy. A directly related previous centered-radial projection result has nonzero first Fourier mode and does not imply the rotational aliasing barrier. Search failure is not novelty proof; residual historical risk remains.

value.rationale: The number of equally spaced source components produces three qualitatively different regimes for a natural circular-model reduction problem: second-order onset for two, first-order coexistence for three, and failure of every concentrated one-kernel fit for four or more. The classification is exact for all parameters and all cardinalities, identifies every optimizer and provides leading critical risk laws. That supplies a mathematically motivated structural boundary for harmonic aliasing in population L2 model compression, rather than an arbitrary low-degree example.
